tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Ludomara Studios** is an independent video-game developer whose online multiplayer title has players on every continent. The game's backend is built as dozens of **containerized microservices** (matchmaking, leaderboards, inventory, chat) that the team packages as container images.

**Current Pain Points:**
- The containers currently run on a handful of manually managed virtual machines; deployments are hand-rolled and a crashed container stays down until someone notices.
- Players in regions far from the game's primary datacenter complain about **slow downloads of game patches and asset packs**, which are large static files.

tabs.title: Requirements
tabs.content:
**Platform Team:**
- Move the microservices to a managed **container orchestration** service that can automatically scale the number of containers with player demand, restart failed containers, and roll out new versions with zero downtime.

**Distribution:**
- Deliver game patches and asset packs to players worldwide from **edge locations close to each player**, caching the files so repeated downloads do not travel back to the origin servers.

**Finance:**
- The studio owns **Windows Server licenses with active Software Assurance** from its on-premises build farm and wants to use them to **reduce the cost of the Windows virtual machines** it will still run in Azure.
